notes.title: Man of Nollyn Patch v1.05
notes.notes:
[p]
Hello, Detectives of Nollyn.
This is Slater Chae, the developer of "Man of Nollyn",

Since Patch v1.02 and the Steam Next Fest (June 2025), several content creators have graciously tried out the Demo. Patch v1.05 was only made possible thanks to their efforts and the generous feedback they shared with me.
This update primarily addresses a frequently reported screen-freezing issue, and revises certain bribery/intimidation clues and interactable objects.

The changes are as follows.

[/p][list][*][p] Game screen won't freeze at refresh rate above 60Hz.
[/p][p][i]Some content creators encountered a crash where the game became stuck on a single frame, all while the music continued, menus worked, and movement remained possible. The game was still running, but visually frozen.
This issue stems from the engine used (RPG Maker MV), which struggles with high refresh rate monitors. If the game isn’t properly frame-limited at the engine level, rendering halts while game logic continues in the background.
With this update, players using high refresh rate monitors should no longer experience this issue.
If you still encounter screen freezes or crashes after the update, please report your experience on the Steam Community discussion page.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][list][*][p] Miles's bribery/intimidation clue has been updated.
[/p][/*][*][p] Clara's base dialogue and her bribery/intimidation clue has been updated.
[/p][p][i]Below is spoiler-heavy content. Please proceed with caution.

[spoiler]When bribed or intimidated, Miles will now mention what day "yesterday" was, giving players a way to deduce the current date.
Previously, this was deliberately avoided to preserve the case's complexity. But to reduce the overall difficulty and offer a greater sense of "reward" for using bribery/intimidation, this information is now included.

For Clara, her base dialogue now includes two pieces of information :
1) Harry hired her “last month.”
2) Clara claims that “Harry never had kids.”
These lines help players infer that Harry’s child was already gone before Clara was hired.
Her bribery/intimidation dialogue now also reveals the true identity of Nancy Heart.
While the name was introduced as a red herring, leaving her identity unresolved turned out to be a poor design choice.
To make Clara’s clue more meaningful and resolve lingering player curiosity, her updated dialogue now clarifies who Nancy is.[/spoiler][/i][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][list][*][p] The content of the small memo on the table in Harry’s library has been updated.
[/p][p][i]Many players described this chapter as "hard."
After reviewing playthroughs, I've realized the difficulty didn’t stem from players thinking incorrectly or the puzzles being too complex. Rather, it was because they struggled to connect the dots, compelling them to resort to blind guessing and repeated rejections, ultimately leading to the case being perceived as frustratingly difficult.
The newly updated evidence that is the small memo Harry left on the table should better help players piece everything together and make those connections more naturally.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]

(ETC)
[/p][list][*][p] Revised Vin Virosa’s final explanation.
[/p][/*][*][p] Unified Japanese translations for Château Valcour, Réserve Royale.
 [/p][/*][/list][p]

Thank you for checking out Man of Nollyn.
As always, your feedback and support in any form are greatly appreciated.
Please feel free to contact me if you encounter any problems while playing.

Hope you have a wonderful day.

Slater.


[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3523520/Man_of_Nollyn/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Man of Nollyn Patch v1.04
notes.notes:
[p]
Detectives of Nollyn. 

Patch v1.04, for Man of Nollyn, is now live.[/p][p]The patch includes a visual upgrade and adjusted post-deduction feedback clarity.[/p][p]Long story short, Katherine’s visuals got an upgrade, and the game will now tell you how many answers were correct after each submission.  [/p][p][/p][list][*][p] Katherine Visual Upgrade[/p][p][/p][p][i]  Katherine's overall design has been improved. The biggest goal of this upgrade was to improve her design while maintaining the vibe of the character.[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p] Post-Deduction Feedback Clarity[/p][p][/p][p]  [i]One of the most talked-about points from the Demo was how the game handled wrong answers during the deduction phase. Until now, the game would only tell you that “one or more answers were incorrect,” without specifying which or how many. With this patch, the game will now let you know the latter, but not the former.[/i][/p][p][i]  This decision was made to reduce unfair frustration, but not so much that the puzzle becomes a process of elimination. Man of Nollyn is a detective game that respects the player's reasoning. The tension of not knowing exactly what went wrong is part of the experience. If the game told you exactly which question was incorrect, it would encourage trial-and-error guessing over actual deduction.[/i]  [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for checking out Man of Nollyn.
As always, your feedback and support in any form are greatly appreciated.
Please feel free to contact me if you encounter any problems while playing.

Hope you have a wonderful day.

Slater.

notes.title: Man of Nollyn Patch v1.02, Ch1 Puzzle Rework
notes.notes:
Hello, Detectives of Nollyn.
This is Slater Chae, the developer of "Man of Nollyn",

It’s been just over a month since the Demo launched.
Since then, the game has received far more attention and love than I could’ve ever expected, along with a generous amount of thoughtful feedback from players.
This update focuses on revisions to Chapter One, the current playable section of the Demo.

The changes are as follows.

[list]
[*] The clue revealed by Miles when bribed or intimidated has been updated.
[*] The clue revealed by Mina when bribed has been updated.
[/list]
[i]Some of you pointed out that Miles’ clue overlapped with Mina’s, and both revealed information that was a little too direct, almost giving away the killer of Harry Heart outright.
Along with the puzzle rework, I've decided to adjust and refine the information these characters share when players choose to bribe or intimidate them.[/i]

[list]
[*] The second question in the investigation has been reworked.
[*] A new inspectable object has been added to Harry’s library table.
[*] The item [A Small Memo], previously found in Harry’s household ledger, has been replaced.
[*] While in Harry's library, Chloe’s explanation of how to calculate the lethal dose of cyanide has been replaced with her interpretation of the newly added item.
[*] Harry’s ledger now mentions a new household expenditure.
[*] A new inspectable object has been added to the desk in Harry’s bedroom.
[/list]
[i]To put it simply, you won’t need a calculator to solve the case anymore.
Originally, the Demo included a puzzle that asked players to apply some basic math to reach a conclusion.
The idea was to use numbers as a storytelling tool, as its objective, logical, and undisputable nature. 

What I've failed to realize is the fact that not everyone finds such game design engaging.
The truth is, however well-designed a puzzle might be, if it doesn’t resonate with players, it’s not doing its job.
With Patch 1.0.2, that puzzle has been reworked.
The goal was to preserve its logic and precision while steering it in a direction that feels more human, plus more in line with the noir tone of the game.[/i]

(ETC)
[list]
[*] Vin Virosa’s final case explanation has been updated.
[*] Franky's dialogue trigger has been updated.
[*] Fixed minor typos. 
[/list]
Thank you for checking out Man of Nollyn.
As always, your feedback and support in any form are greatly appreciated.
Please feel free to contact me if you encounter any problems while playing.

Hope you have a wonderful day.

Slater.

notes.title: 'Man of Nollyn' Demo Release
notes.notes:
Hello, Detectives of Nollyn!
This is Slater Chae, developer of the game Man of Nollyn.

After a long wait, I’m proud to announce the official release of the Man of Nollyn Demo.
Embark on the investigation into the death of Harry Heart, a filthy rich man found dead in his mansion.
Talk to suspects, search for clues you find useful, and help two kind-hearted policewomen solve the mystery.

The Demo features the first chapter out of six (or possibly more) from the full game.
Estimated playtime is around one hour, and should give you an idea of the game's structure, design, atmosphere, and overall direction.

Thank you for checking out Man of Nollyn.
As always, your feedback and support in any form is greatly appreciated.
Please feel free to contact me if you encounter any problems while playing.


Hope you have a wonderful day.

Slater.
